name: Adaptive Target Intelligence & Attack-Surface Graph
description: The Target Intelligence layer that evolves HunterX from a tool runner into an adaptive security reasoning system. Every target is represented as a continuously evolving attack-surface graph backed by immutable observations, explicit coverage, explicit uncertainty, hypotheses to validate, an explainable next-action engine that selects the smallest justified tool set, and full replayability from stored artifacts. It extends Sprint 017 topology, Sprint 021/022 proof & validation, Sprint 023 tool intelligence and Sprint 025 tool mastery without redesigning them.
inputs: IntelligenceTarget (canonical target entity, never a bare hostname)
Observation stream (immutable, provenance-carrying) from tool parsers and SDK executions
IntelligenceAsset graph nodes and topology relationships
mission objective, safety ceiling and authorization status
available tools, tool capabilities, cost, risk and previous executions (Sprint 023/025)
known-vulnerability and technology knowledge (CVE/CWE where available)
outputs: CoverageMatrix (Target x Asset x Capability x Tool x State)
InformationGap list (explicit uncertainty, never negative knowledge)
Hypothesis list (conjectures to validate, including UNKNOWN_BEHAVIOR/NOVEL_VARIANT)
ranked, explainable IntelligenceAction list with stop conditions and fallbacks
NegativeResult (carefully scoped, capability + tool + conditions + coverage)
IntelligenceScore (explainable multi-dimension, never a single opaque number)
ReplayRun (artifact -> observation -> correlation -> hypothesis -> action, no re-execution)
decision_policies: priority = information_gain + hypothesis_relevance + coverage_gap + evidence_value + proof_value - execution_cost - risk - redundancy
weights are configurable via RankingWeights and recorded on IntelligenceDecision (target-intelligence/ranking/1.0.0)
negative results are scoped: tested_capability + tool + scope + conditions + coverage, never global 'not vulnerable'
conflicting tool results are preserved and escalated, never averaged
tool selection delegates to the Sprint 025 mission-aware selector; selection never widens scope or authorization
missing information is UNKNOWN/NOT_ASSESSED, never negative
novel behavior enters hypotheses without requiring a CVE or signature
every action carries stop conditions and a fallback
AI output is advisory; scope/authorization/safety/proof policy always override
all decisions preserve provenance and are replayable from stored artifacts
guardrails: tenant/mission/scope isolation enforced on every ingestion (TargetIntelligenceScopeEnforcer)
observations are immutable; corrections are new observations that supersede
actions exceeding the safety ceiling are blocked or re-tooled
no hardcoded universal tool sequence; the next-action engine ranks from intelligence state
no black-box action selection; every decision carries rationale, alternatives and policy
scores are never a single opaque number; each dimension is reported with its weight
proof integration follows Sprint 021/022: DISCOVER -> VALIDATE -> PROVE, avoiding redundant discovery

persistence.store: TIDB normalized entities (never a JSON dump of the whole graph)

testing: replay: artifact -> parser -> observation -> correlation -> hypothesis -> action without re-execution
never_executes: actions above the safety ceiling without authorization
findings confirmed solely by scanner output (validation + proof required)
redundant discovery once proof is justified
